verdict.rationale: Galileo captures sessions, traces, and spans (galileo-docs-6) and exposes session-level metrics (galileo-docs-24) plus cost-related alerting (galileo-docs-14), which implies some usage/cost visibility. However, there is no explicit documentation of attaching custom metadata (e.g., user ID, feature tag) to logs/traces specifically for cost or usage attribution purposes. Missing for 10: explicit custom-metadata tagging API/fields for cost attribution, per-user/per-feature cost breakdown dashboards, and independent confirmation of this attribution workflow.
